mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blocked_emails (email_hash, user_id, sanction_id, reason, created_by) VALUES (#{emailHash}, #{userId}, #{sanctionId}, #{reason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blocked_emails WHERE email_hash = #{emailHash} AND released_at IS NULL
SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM blocked_emails b WHERE b.user_id = u.id ) ORDER BY u.deleted_at, u.id LIMIT #{limit}
